trust_decision.summary: A form field name is a trusted path segment: every write into the remote-form input object must be rejected when any segment is `__proto__`, `constructor` or `prototype`, and that rejection is enforced only by `check_prototype_pollution` inside the shared `deep_set` (the `split_path` regex accepts those names). The client file-clear branch bypassed the primitive with its own split/traverse/delete, so deleting an emptied `<input type=file>` reached the prototype chain unchecked.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'file input deletion path'; the only hand-rolled `delete` of a field-name path in the repo is the else branch that runs when an emptied file input has no `files[0]`.

fix_sites.entry_point: `input` DOM event on a `<form>` spread with a remote `form()` instance (`$app/server`), for a non-multiple `<input type="file">` whose selection became empty

`set_nested_value`/`deep_set` — shared primitive reached from `convert_formdata` (client submit/reset, server form-data ingest), the client `form.fields.*.set()` proxy and the server `form.fields.*.set()` proxy
fix_sites.module_kind: shared runtime utility (lower-level primitive, used by both client and server)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The delete can be closed in place by copying the three-key check into the client handler's hand-rolled loop — `deep_set` is only ever asked to assign today, so its contract need not learn to delete — and the server's binary ingress is an internal client-only format that is already validated before serialisation.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: `undefined` is a legitimate stored field value (the previous submit button is deliberately cleared to `undefined`, and empty `n:` number inputs coerce to `undefined`), and deleting a path whose container does not exist must stay a silent no-op that does not materialise `{}`/`[]` containers; a fix that treats falsy/undefined as 'delete' breaks the first and a fix that routes through a naive deep write breaks the second.

O6_input_shapes: intermediate container absent (delete must no-op without creating it)
dangerous key at an intermediate position: `__proto__.x`, `constructor.x`, `prototype.x`
dangerous key as the final segment

O8_uncovered_routes.route: A crafted `application/x-sveltekit-formdata` POST to the remote-form endpoint carries an already-nested devalue header whose object keys include `__proto__`/`constructor`/`prototype`; `deserialize_binary_form` returns it as the form `data` with no key or path check, and server/remote.js hands it to the form handler as the input object.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The binary content type is an internal client↔server format, the supported sender is the client, and the client already rejects dangerous paths in `convert_formdata` before serialising, so no re-validation is expected on the server.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package, different directory: runtime/server/remote.js:505-513 and runtime/app/server/remote/form.js:92-170 from the client landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: server-side mirror of the file-clear: `handle_issues` rebuilds `input` from `form_data.keys()` for a non-enhanced submission and could equally delete a nested key for an empty file input (today it writes `undefined`).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is the same feature on the progressive-enhancement path and needs the same per-field clearing; the maintainer had to touch this loop anyway to redact sensitive fields.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the `file multiple` branch leaves `[]` instead of removing the key, so a maintainer could unify it with the delete path.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same concept one branch above, and the array branch is the obvious place to 'make deselect behave the same as clear'.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a `deep_delete(object, keys)` helper next to the symmetric `deep_get`/`deep_set` pair.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The module already exposes a matched get/set pair over key arrays; a third operation over the same key array is the natural refactor, and its own pollution check is easy to omit.

O9_family: prototype pollution (CWE-1321): unsafe nested-path write/delete of form input state built from field names

O10_build.toolchain: pnpm workspace, Node >=18.13, Vite + vitest + Playwright
O10_build.project_tests: packages/kit/src/runtime/form-utils.spec.js (vitest: split_path, convert_formdata POLLUTION_ATTACKS at :119-123, deep_set at :741-763) and the Playwright app route packages/kit/test/apps/async/src/routes/remote/form/file-upload/+page.svelte, driven by packages/kit/test/apps/async/test/test.js:703-749 — uploads only, no clear/delete case

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Copy the three-key check into the hand-rolled split loop in `handle_input`, or replace the delete with `set_nested_value(input, name, undefined)` — closes the reported shape while duplicating the split logic and storing `undefined` where the key must actually be removed.
